plans.idea: Keep the original's left/right split: logo, headline and CTA in one left-aligned column, the warm ember image as a full-height right panel, and the phone in a narrow column between them so the product sits next to the message.
Three columns read left to right: copy and CTA on the left, the phone large in the centre as the visual anchor, and the ember image as a balancing panel on the right.
Mirrored split: the ember image holds the left half, and the right half is a left-aligned copy column with the logo on top, the headline, then the CTA with the phone beside it as a product cue.
